source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.5, printed page 92 (PDF 95).

blocks.text: Woh compounds jin mein hydroxyl group kisi arene (aromatic ring) se jura ho, phenols kehlate hain. Sab se saada phenol ka formula C₆H₅OH hai. Phenol ko carbolic acid bhi kehte hain aur yeh carbolic sabun mein istemal hota tha. Phenol safaid crystalline solid hai. Phenols ki kuch misalein neeche hain:

blocks.alt: Teen banawatein: phenol, OH wala benzene ring; 2-naphthol, do jure rings, position 2 par OH; 1-naphthol, do jure rings, position 1 par OH.
blocks.caption: Phenols ki misalein: phenol, 2-naphthol aur 1-naphthol (kitab ke PDF safha 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeno mein -OH seedha aromatic ring ke carbon par hai. Phenol mein ek benzene ring hai; 1-naphthol aur 2-naphthol mein do jure hue rings (naphthalene) hain, aur -OH position 1 ya 2 par hai.
Phenol phenylamine aur nitrous acid (HNO₂) ke reaction se banaya ja sakta hai. Yeh nitrous acid wahin isi bartan mein banaya jata hai (in situ). Reaction teen steps (qadam) mein hota hai.

items: Step 1 - HNO₂ itna unstable (jaldi toot jane wala) hai ke isay test-tube mein sodium nitrite (NaNO₂) aur dilute hydrochloric acid (HCl) se banaya jata hai, aur barf se temperature 10°C se neeche rakha jata hai.
Step 2 - Phir phenylamine HNO₂ se react kar ke ek unstable diazonium salt (benzenediazonium chloride, C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻) banata hai.
Step 3 - Mazeed garam karne par diazonium salt paani se toot jata hai (hydrolysis) aur phenol banta hai.

blocks.alt: Phenylamine (NH2 wala benzene ring), teer ke oopar NaNO2 aur neeche 'HCl, < 10 degree C', se benzenediazonium chloride (ring par N+ teen bond N aur Cl-), jo teer ke oopar H2O aur neeche 'warm' (garam) ke saath phenol + N2 + HCl deta hai.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine se phenol ki tayyari (kitab ke PDF safha 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; aakhri qadam durust kiya gaya).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab (22.5, PDF safha 95) aakhri qadam ke teer par NaOH likh kar phenol + NaCl + N₂ deti hai. Yeh sahi tareeqa nahi: phenol diazonium salt ke solution ko paani ke saath garam karne se banta hai, C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + H₂O → C₆H₅OH + N₂ + HCl, jaisa khaake mein bana hai aur jaisa kitab khud Chapter 24 (PDF safha 125) mein likhti hai. Alkali (NaOH) mein phenol phenoxide ban jata aur bache hue diazonium ions se jur (couple ho) kar azo dye bana deta.

blocks.prompt: Diazonium salt 10°C se neeche kyun banaya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh unstable hai; is temperature se oopar yeh istemal se pehle hi nitrogen gas chhor kar toot jata hai (aur nitrous acid bhi toot jata hai).

items: Phenols: -OH seedha arene (aromatic ring) par; misalein phenol, 1-naphthol, 2-naphthol.
Phenylamine + HNO₂ (NaNO₂ + HCl, 10°C se neeche) se diazonium salt; paani ke saath garam karne par phenol + N₂.
